notes: Village of Kronenwetter news page: 'World Famous' Friday fish fry draws ~400 customers weekly. Family-run in a renovated bank building. Also in WPR's Lenten guide under a Rothschild mailing address. Confirm exact Friday lineup and whether cod is offered. Closed Sundays.

Own website publishes the full fish fry. Serving since 1926. Haddock baked or fried 2pc $9.50 / 3pc $11.50, 7pc shrimp $13.50, walleye $18. Coleslaw, bread, fries or potato salad. Dine-in or takeout. Attached ballroom - good sponsor story.
Countryside tavern in the Town of Green Valley (south Marathon County), Mosinee mailing address. Cod, walleye, perch, jumbo gulf shrimp Fridays. Also known for broasted chicken. Closed Mon-Tue.
Bar near the Big Eau Pleine Flowage, south Marathon County. Perch and walleye called out; deep-fried walleye and grilled shrimp are listed favorites. Confirm whether cod is on the Friday board.

Downtown cafe open 6AM-2PM six days but stays open Friday evening for the fish fry. Beer-batter fish, Poor Man's, shrimp basket, combo. Formerly S & S Cafe. Sources disagree on Friday close (7PM vs 8PM) and address (313 vs 400 Main St) - verify.

venue_name: Chang's Half Moon Lakeview Bar & Grill
notes: On Half Moon Bay with boat landing, next door to Pinewood Supper Club. Breaded and beer-battered options cited. 'A Hmong twist on an old classic' - distinctive listing. Species not sourced. Closed Mon-Tue.

Country bar known for Friday fish fries, home-cooked by owner Zena. ADDRESS CONFLICT: Yelp says 2103 County Rd C, WiscoBars/Restaurantji say 155835 County Rd C - verify before geocoding. Closed Mon-Wed.

COUNTY CHECK NEEDED. On Lake DuBay with boat docking; Friday fish fry cited. Some directories place it in Portage or Wood County - Lake DuBay is at the three-county corner. Confirm Marathon County before listing.

One of only three Kronenwetter drinking establishments. A directory blurb mentions Friday fish frys but reads AI-generated; no primary source. 2026 review praises the walleye sandwich. Worth one call given Kronenwetter coverage. Closed Tuesdays.
Full-kitchen bar on Hwy 153, same corridor as Hog Creek and Salty Bones. Fish fry asserted only by a search summary, no primary source. Phone call needed.
In the TOWN OF BERGEN, Marathon County - only Bergen venue found. Real kitchen; opens 11AM Fridays vs 2PM other days, which usually signals a fry, but unconfirmed. Closed Mon-Tue.
Tavern in Dancy, TOWN OF KNOWLTON - one of few Knowlton-proper venues besides Knowlton House Distillery. No kitchen confirmed either way. Worth a call.
Rural Hwy 153 tavern, directory listing only, no menu online at all. Classic no-web-presence profile that often runs an unlisted Friday fry. Phone call needed.
Country bar with bar games. No food info, no phone sourced. Same County Rd C stretch as Z Place 2 Be.
Rural pub, south Marathon County. Directory listing only.
In-town Mosinee bar, 20 taps, serves burgers and pizza. Has a kitchen but no fish fry mentioned anywhere.
Directory listing only; no food, hours, or phone sourced.
Downtown Mosinee corner bar. No food information found.
Third Kronenwetter establishment. Yelp indicates NO FOOD SERVED - fish fry unlikely; included so the Kronenwetter sweep is provably complete.
Hosts Friday night karaoke but no food or fish fry documented.
Well-reviewed (4.7) Rothschild pub. No menu info, no phone sourced.
Craft taproom in an old bank, 4.9 stars. Food from a rotating food truck, not an in-house kitchen - traditional fry unlikely.
Southeast Marathon County. Travel Wisconsin lists fish fry as a cuisine type; county best-of finalist for bar food, Bloody Mary and Fish; voted best burger in the area. Species and hours not sourced.
